title: This one is the one. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
body: I'm not one to write reviews but I'm taking my time on this one. As someone with ADHD this drastically upgraded my productivity, I hate to be this dramatic but it's actually life changing 😂 From all the productivity apps I've seen and used (often specifically marketed as "adhd friendly"), this is the only one that sticks. I won't even pick up pen and paper to jot something down and somehow this still manages to be straight forward enough for me to actively use it in my day to day. There are minor features that I'd like to see (duplicating a task would be nice) but this app without a question gets a major five stars from me!

title: Disgruntled 4-year subscriber due to MAJOR BUG
body: I’ve been using the paid version of TickTick since Dec. 2019. I was quite happy about the app, until yesterday (8 April 2024) where I saw (i) previously completed tasks coming back on my to-do list, (ii) tasks with wrong due dates, (iii) categories removed. A BIG MESS. That should not happen, never! And when it does, the developer should react swiftly to the tickets you log. First ticket was logged yesterday at 18:32 CET. 14 hours later, still no reaction.

title: Clean and simple. The way i like it!
body:
I’ve only recently installed this app and haven’t used it much yet but it is clean and simple looking. With simple i mean not overcrowded like most similar apps.
You can make folders, lists within those folders and then add any task you want. Comes with a useful calendar, set reminders, etc.
No annoying banners or ads which is great.
App is even available in my language (for the most part).
Would recommend this app to anyone looking for a good to do list which is clean and easy to use.
Thank you developer! 5*
